about: A live run of T13-drawing-board, recorded for replay.

value.interfacePart: A simple drawing board where I can sketch with the mouse.

features.name: Mouse sketching
features.request: where I can sketch with the mouse

value.name: Drawing board
value.summary: Sketch with the mouse, pen or finger. Pick a color and brush size, use the eraser, or clear the board.

code.html:
Drawing board

4 px

Press and drag on the board to draw.

value.interfacePart: Make the brush thicker and add a red colour.

value.summary: The brush is now thicker: it starts at 8 px and can go up to 80 px. A new Red button sets the pen colour to red.

code.html:
Drawing board

8 px

Press and drag on the board to draw.

value.summary: This drawing board already has an eraser. Press the Eraser button, then drag on the board to rub out. Press Pen to draw again. I changed nothing.
